typography_findings.symptom: The title renders entirely in lowercase and omits the standard hyphenation/capitalization of the Auslander–Buchsbaum name.
typography_findings.suggested_repair: Use a display title such as “Auslander–Buchsbaum first syzygy”.

typography_findings.excerpt: title: "regular local ring satisfies r one"
typography_findings.symptom: The title prints the name of the condition as plain lowercase words, unlike the mathematical notation used in the statement.
typography_findings.suggested_repair: Use “A regular local ring satisfies $(R_1)$” or an equivalent display title.

typography_findings.excerpt: title: "regular local regular quotient ideal is parameter generated"
typography_findings.symptom: The title renders entirely in lowercase, which is visually inconsistent with the neighboring display titles.
typography_findings.suggested_repair: Capitalize the title, for example “A regular quotient of a regular local ring is parameter generated”.
